tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience certificate showing that the bidder has carried out similar work during the preceding three years (2022-23, 2023-24, and 2024-25). Any of the one year has to achieve Rs.8,00,000/- of the tender value in government institutions, government/semi-government organizations, district hospitals, hospitals, hostels or universities, as applicable.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration certificate of the firm/agency.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Self-declaration that the bidder has not been blacklisted by any government or semi-government institution.
Self-declaration of similar running business and work order has to be uploaded.
Income-tax paid returns/details for the financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25.
GST Registration Certificate issued by the competent tax authority.
Annual Turnover Statement for the last three years (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25) and turnover bidder has to achieve Rs.20.00lk turnover any one of the year, certified by a Chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
